geometry.caseSetStatement: For this frozen set of five cases, the previously bundled "orientation or segmentation" category resolves to segmentation-suspected, based on geometry-only blinded review. Every reader-estimated baseline sat within 2 degrees of horizontal; no item met the >15-degree or vertical-text condition for ORIENTATION_SUSPECTED, and no item was called AMBIGUOUS_SUBLABEL.
geometry.prevalenceClaimProhibitedBecause: n=5. This is a case-set mechanism statement, not a rate over the governed corpus or production.
